no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee Meeting was not viewed by the Division as necessary, prior to accelerated approval of this drug.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the PREZISTA (darunavir) NDA 21-976; the clinical review's section 8.5 states the Division did not view an AC meeting as necessary prior to accelerated approval. A review passage references general discussions at an Antiviral Drugs Advisory Committee meeting about mortality trends in antiretroviral trials, but that was not a committee convened for this application. Because no AC was held, there are no concern-to-change linkages to report.
